Context: small sales enablement startup building lightweight call-summary + coaching widgets for SMBs. Primary pain: sales reps spend too much time writing notes; want reliable, concise meeting summaries and CRM snippets. Inbound came from pricing page after reading blog post on low-latency summaries.

User quotes / ask: "we need to make sure customer PII (emails, phones) never persists longer than necessary"; legal asked: "can we set retention to 30 days and delete logs?".

Technical details captured: sampling transcripts are 15–25 minutes; average transcript size ~7k tokens; expected concurrent users low (5–10) but peak bursts during end-of-quarter outreach. Target latency: summary returned <2s per 256-token output for interactive UX; batch nightly rerun for CRM enrichment acceptable. Cost sensitivity: high — will evaluate token-level pricing and request predictability.

Security / operations notes: Interested in hosted API but needs clear defaults for retention and an opt-out for server-side storage. Asked about audit logs and whether Redwood provides redact/PII-mask guidance. SE demoed client-side hashing before upload and server-side partial redaction examples — customer prefers client-side masking if possible.

Sales cues: Good early traction potential — funnel originates from content. Low ARR initially; upsell potential if they add Dedicated for higher throughput in future.
